section.p: Consider a "Review Performance Metrics" chapter in a "User Guide" document where you want a block image in an info element. You want to show the screen in the info tag with some information by adding placement="break" to an <image> element and/or wrapping the image in a<fig>element.
section.codeblock:
Open the dashboard and review performance metrics. Log in and navigate to Dashboard & Performance.

The following screenshot highlights the key metrics:

 …

You can identify any abnormal metric spikes and export metrics for analysis.
section.p: Result: Using the <image placement="break"> and/or wrapping the image in <fig> inside an <info> gives you a full-width block screenshot with descriptive context.
